title: The Fifth Page Reveals Itself
next_chapter_hook: Yet just as Chen Ji was immersed in the power of Cause and Effect Co-Scribing, the yellowed page began to slowly seep dark red patterns—a price he had never seen in any record.

text.content: Deep within the silver-white Mental Sea, Chen Ji floated in the Void. The sleeping consciousnesses around him were like ancient stars, emitting faint and desolate light. He finally understood—each of these points of light had once been a candidate for the Tianji Record—just like him, chosen by fate, then abandoned by fate.

At that moment, the cover of the Tianji Record automatically turned to the fifth page. On the yellowed paper, the originally blurry patterns gradually became clear as if moistened by flowing water. Chen Ji's pupils constricted—that was neither text nor pattern, but a floating brush, a brush condensed from pure cause-and-effect power.

dialogue.content: “Cause and Effect Co-Scribing…” The voice of the remnant soul guardian came from deep within the paper pages, carrying a tremor Chen Ji had never heard before. “You have finally reached this step.” Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul image appeared beside Chen Ji, and an unusually grave expression appeared on that blurred face. “Write the cause, and you set the effect. From this day forward, you are the only Writer in this world.”

text.content: Chen Ji reached out, and the moment his fingertip touched that cause-and-effect brush, a majestic suffocating force flooded into his Mental Sea. He saw—saw the threads of cause and effect connecting all things in the universe, golden threads linking everything between heaven and earth, every thought, every choice leaving an eternal mark on the web of causality.

dialogue.content: “So that's how it is…” Chen Ji murmured, his eyes glittering with excited yet dangerous light. “I can write the cause, and I can rewrite the effect. Ling Yuan's thousand-year scheme, Han Lie's invincible legend, even the will of the Heavenly Eye—” His lips curved slightly upward. “If I wish, any of them can be turned to dust with a single stroke of my brush.”

text.content: Yet before his words finished, that cause-and-effect brush shuddered violently. At the same moment, above the Tianqing Sect Main Peak, the stone door of Ling Yuan's seclusion shattered; deep within the Xuanwu Sect Forbidden Grounds, the black iron token in Han Lie's hand crumbled to powder; and in the deepest part of the Nine Abyss Demon Domain, a massive eye spanning the heavens slowly opened—the projection of the Heavenly Eye.

Three transcendent wills simultaneously locked onto the direction of the Tianqing Sect Servants' Peak. Ling Yuan's voice pierced the clouds: “The fifth page of the Tianji Record…completed at this moment?” An unusual hint of wariness appeared in his tone. And far beyond thousands of miles away, Han Lie's forehead veins bulged as he roared: “That废物! How does he deserve this!”

dialogue.content: Just then, a cold voice rang in Chen Ji's mind—a voice belonging to no one he knew, yet carrying a bone-chilling pressure: “Cause and Effect Co-Scribing…interesting. But do you know how the last prophet who mastered this authority met their end?” The voice carried the playful tone of a hunter examining prey. “I shall be watching with great interest.”

text.content: Chen Ji withdrew his focus and冷笑一声. Fear? Hmph, from the day Chen Ji stepped into the cultivation world, he had lived in fear—fear of exposing his identity, fear of having the Tianji Record taken, fear of never finding his sister Chen Nian. But now it was different. The moment the cause-and-effect brush was in his hand, he finally had the qualification to overturn the chessboard.

choice.prompt: Three forces simultaneously locked onto him, the time limit merely three breaths. Chen Ji knew that the choice at this moment would determine the pattern of the world to come.

choices.description: Use the cause-and-effect brush to write a proclamation, announcing the birth of the Tianji Record's new master to the three sects. Overawe the petty with absolute momentum, let the world know—Chen Ji is no废物.
choices.visible_cost: Immediately become the target of all, the three sects will surely unite in a siege
choices.visible_reward: Reputation will skyrocket, the world will be astounded, followers drawn by fame will rapidly expand power
choices.risk_hint: The risk is extremely high, but success will completely break the three major sects' monopoly on public opinion

text.content: Chen Ji did not hesitate in the slightest. The cause-and-effect brush condensed in his palm, and with a light sweep, golden ink spread across the sky—a proclamation written with cause-and-effect power, each character as heavy as a mountain.

dialogue.content: “From this day, the fifth page of the Tianji Record reveals itself. Chen Ji, born with destiny, shall hold the pen to set all worldly causes and effects.” His voice pierced the nine heavens. “If the esteemed seniors have objections—” He smiled, the smile warm yet carrying the cold edge of a blade. “Feel free to visit Servants' Peak for a chat.”

choices.description: Immediately suppress his aura, reducing the cause-and-effect brush's fluctuations to the lowest level. Let the three sects believe the Tianji Record's fifth page has merely begun to manifest, wait for them to lower their guard, then strike them one by one. Playing the pig to eat the tiger—that is his true colors.
choices.visible_cost: Abandon this prime opportunity to震慑 the three sects
choices.visible_reward: Gain precious time for maneuvering, the three sects' mutual suspicion will create internal friction
choices.risk_hint: If exposed, public trust will be lost, and the three sects may accelerate their alliance

text.content: Chen Ji's intention shifted, and that world-shocking cause-and-effect brush instantly turned into a wisp of blue smoke, sinking deep into his Mental Sea. The fifth page of the Tianji Record's aura also subsided, as if it had never awakened at all.

dialogue.content: “It seems it has merely begun to manifest, not yet completed.” He spoke to himself, deliberately letting weakness seep into his voice. “The Tianqing Sect Founder's protection…was still somewhat lacking after all.” The acting was flawless, that self-deprecating smile enough to convince anyone—Chen Ji, that废物, was still that废物.

choices.description: Use the cause-and-effect brush's power to respectively display to the three sects the answers they most desire as bargaining chips. Trade information for time, trade the future for the present, carve out time for the Tianji Record's complete awakening from the gaps between powers.
choices.visible_cost: Must expose part of the cause-and-effect power as a gesture of sincerity
choices.visible_reward: Obtain the three sects' temporary retreat, winning a crucial buffer period
choices.risk_hint: Any flaw in negotiation may be seized upon and exploited by the other party

text.content: Chen Ji did not choose to clash head-on. Instead, he condensed the cause-and-effect power into three illusory cause-and-effect seals. He tossed his hand, and the three seals flew through the air in three directions—Tianqing Sect, Xuanwu Sect, and Nine Abyss Demon Domain.

dialogue.content: “Three esteemed seniors need not be alarmed.” Chen Ji's voice was calm as still water, yet clearly reached all three of their ears. “The junior merely wishes to make a trade—I give you the answers you desire, you give me three years' time. Three years from now, you may deal with the junior as you see fit.”

text.content: Three breaths of silence felt like three years. Finally, Ling Yuan's voice sounded again: “Three years? Heh, you certainly have an appetite.” A hint of playfulness appeared in his tone. “But this old one is quite interested in your cause-and-effect brush—how about this, you and I have a private conversation?.”

dialogue.content: Meanwhile, Han Lie's roar also spread across half the cultivation world: “Trade? Who do you think you are! A mere废物 dares to negotiate terms with this seat!” Yet the moment his words fell, one cause-and-effect seal had quietly sunk into his brow—a segment of cause and effect Chen Ji had written in advance.

text.content: Chen Ji watched Han Lie's face suddenly stiffen, his lips curving slightly upward. What did he see? He saw that in three months Han Lie would fall into a deadly trap due to underestimating his opponent; saw that Han Lie's supposedly invincible Xuanwu True Body would shatter at a critical moment due to a tiny crack; saw that this废物 in Han Lie's mouth would become his greatest nightmare.

“Cause and Effect Co-Scribing…” Chen Ji murmured, feeling the pulse transmitted from the cause-and-effect brush in his Mental Sea. “Truly useful indeed.” He closed his eyes, beginning to write the first true cause and effect—about himself. “Within three years, Chen Ji shall not be killed by any external force.” He wrote. The moment the brush stroke fell, an invisible barrier enveloped his entire body.

choice.prompt: The power of Cause and Effect Co-Scribing was so great, but Mo Xiansheng had said—the more complete the Tianji Record, the stronger fate's inevitable backlash becomes. Just as Chen Ji was about to continue writing, he sensed something was wrong.

choices.description: Immediately stop writing and carefully examine the cause-and-effect brush's method of operation. Now that he has obtained power, he should understand this power's boundaries and costs. He never wages wars without preparation.
choices.visible_cost: May miss the opportunity to strike while the iron is hot
choices.visible_reward: Discover hidden dangers in advance, creating opportunities for countermeasures
choices.risk_hint: The cost may far exceed expectations, requiring cautious treatment
choices.process_label: 以神识探查因果之笔核心

text.content: Chen Ji probed the core of the cause-and-effect brush with his divine sense, only to witness a scene that chilled his heart—the brush tip was slowly devouring his Heavenly Fate Value. With every cause and effect he wrote, his lifespan would decrease by a fraction. And the “immortal barrier” he had just written had already devoured a full thirty years of his lifespan.

dialogue.content: “Heh…” Chen Ji laughed lowly, yet there was no panic in his eyes. He looked at that yellowed page, his voice terrifyingly calm. “Thirty years of lifespan in exchange for an immortal guarantee? This deal is not bad.” He paused. “But—how many thirty years do I have left to squander?”

choices.description: Since the cause-and-effect brush is already in hand, the cost can wait until later. What matters most now is consolidating advantages, writing as many self-beneficial causes and effects as possible before the three sects can unite.
choices.visible_cost: Lifespan is heavily devoured, the body begins to show abnormalities
choices.visible_reward: Establish absolute advantage in a short time, cause-and-effect power becomes unrivaled
choices.risk_hint: Overuse may lead to Heavenly Fate Value reaching zero, consequences unimaginable
choices.process_label: 继续书写因果，扩大优势

text.content: Chen Ji did not stop. He continued to raise his brush, frantically writing cause after cause in his Mental Sea. “Su Qingyao will forever trust Chen Ji” “Ye Qing's demonic path mist will perfectly conceal the Tianji Record's aura” “Chen Nian's clues will automatically surface within one month”—with each line written, he felt himself drawing closer to death.

dialogue.content: But he did not care. Twenty years of lifespan in exchange for a sister? An ever-loyal confidante? An ally that perfectly conceals his aura? Too valuable. He冷笑 in his heart—Chen Ji had crawled out of a pile of corpses from the beginning anyway, every day lived was a gain.

text.content: Yet at this moment, that yellowed page suddenly began to shake violently. Dark red patterns spread from the fifth page's core, like some ancient curse awakening. Chen Ji looked down to see those patterns蠕动 in a strange pattern—they formed a face, a face he had never seen yet somehow felt familiar.

dialogue.content: “I have found you, the fifth Writer.” The lips of that face slowly moved, the voice being that cold will that had spoken in his mind earlier. “Everyone who masters Cause and Effect Co-Scribing will eventually become part of me. You—will be no exception.” The voice carried an overbearing arrogance. “The wheels of fate have begun to turn, and you…are merely one gear about to be crushed.”

text.content: Chen Ji stared at that蠕动的 face, then suddenly smiled. That smile was gentle, composed, even carrying a hint of compassion, as if what he saw was not a terrifying existence capable of destroying heaven and earth, but a pitiful creature that did not yet understand its impending failure. “Heavenly Eye?” he murmured softly. “You merely used me as a chess piece for a thousand years. But you forgot one thing—” He gripped the cause-and-effect brush tight, its tip blooming with dazzling light. “Chen Ji has never been a chess piece to be manipulated.”

The words fell, and Chen Ji abruptly raised his brush. He did not write any specific cause and effect, but directly drew a circle on the blank space of the fifth page—a circle completely enclosing that face. “The first rule of Cause and Effect Co-Scribing.” he said slowly. “A Writer may write any cause and effect, but first—he must ensure he survives to the moment of writing.” The circle completed, the curse patterns abruptly halted, and that face let out an angry roar.

“You—” The Heavenly Eye's voice showed fluctuations for the first time. “You incorporated the Tianji Record's own curse into your cause-and-effect loop? You're mad! This means every time you use cause-and-effect power, you will—” Chen Ji interrupted: “Accelerate the arrival of that inevitable backlash?” He laughed, the smile carrying desperate madness. “So what? This life of mine was never mine to begin with. Rather than being used as a chess piece until I'm spent—better to actively detonate this game!”

choice.prompt: The Heavenly Eye's voice echoed in the Mental Sea, and Chen Ji felt the pressure from that face—power beyond his comprehension. But at the same time, the cause-and-effect brush's pulse grew ever clearer, as if awaiting his next command.

choices.description: While that face is trapped, use the cause-and-effect brush to write a cause and effect about the Heavenly Eye—making its will unable to interfere with the Tianji Record's Writer again. Stake everything, burn the bridges.
choices.visible_cost: May trigger the Heavenly Eye's full-scale counterattack, cost incalculable
choices.visible_reward: Completely sever the Heavenly Eye's connection with the Tianji Record, attaining true freedom
choices.risk_hint: This is a gamble against heaven, victory or defeat merely fifty-fifty

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath and raised his brush to write. Yet the moment the brush tip touched the paper's surface, a pressure足以撕裂苍穹 descended. That was the Heavenly Eye's full-force strike—it would rather damage its own foundation than allow this cause and effect to take shape.

dialogue.content: “Chen Ji!” Mo Xiansheng's voice suddenly rang out, carrying unprecedented urgency. “Your current state cannot withstand heaven's backlash! If this cause and effect is written—” Chen Ji did not heed him, the brush stroke依旧坚定地落下. Blood gushed from all seven orifices simultaneously, dying that cause-and-effect brush crimson.

choices.description: Forcefully retract the cause-and-effect power, do not confront the Heavenly Eye directly. Today's gains are already sufficient—the ability of Cause and Effect Co-Scribing, the three sects' wariness, and a probe into the Heavenly Eye. Now is the time to retreat one step and consolidate foundations.
choices.visible_cost: Lose the best opportunity to deal a heavy blow to the Heavenly Eye
choices.visible_reward: Preserve strength, accumulating power for future decisive battles
choices.risk_hint: The Heavenly Eye will become more vigilant, increasing future difficulty

text.content: Chen Ji did not act rashly. He turned his wrist, the cause-and-effect brush flowing into the depths of his Mental Sea, and that circle trapping the Heavenly Eye dissipated along with it. “Let us end today's session here.” he said calmly. “If the senior wishes to take the junior's life, feel free to come to Servants' Peak—but the junior reminds you, the last senior who came here is currently in reflection at the Tianqing Sect Back Mountain.”

dialogue.content: That蠕动的 face fell silent for a moment, then let out a meaningful laugh: “Interesting…truly interesting. Chen Ji, you are far more entertaining than any Writer I have ever seen.” The voice gradually faded. “But remember—you have already entered this chess game. To extract yourself now? That will be difficult.” The words fell, and that suffocating pressure vanished.

text.content: The Mental Sea returned to tranquility. Chen Ji slowly opened his eyes. In the small cottage on Servants' Peak, everything was as before, as if that earth-shaking confrontation had merely been an illusion. But he knew it was not—because the cause-and-effect brush still floated quietly in his Mental Sea, emitting its unique light. And on that yellowed page, the position of the fifth page was now completely filled, golden patterns flowing within, heartbreakingly beautiful.

“Cause and Effect Co-Scribing…” Chen Ji murmured, feeling the pulse transmitted from that brush. Yet just as he prepared to细细体悟 this power, the paper's edge slowly began to seep dark red patterns—patterns unlike any cost he had seen before, thicker, older, more…like blood. Mo Xiansheng's voice softly sounded: “The fifth page is complete…but the cost has always been collected in advance.” Chen Ji looked down to see those dark red patterns spreading along his palm lines, and where they passed, the blood vessels beneath his skin visibly turned golden—the mark of Heavenly Fate blood being burned away.
